title: Childhood Apraxia of Speech Info - Videos
description:
Childhood Apraxia of Speech (CAS) is a rare motor speech disorder. Specialized treatment is important. Approximately 1 to 2 children out of 1,000 have CAS. Children with CAS have difficulty planning and programming the necessary movements to produce speech. Accurate apraxia diagnosis and specialized treatment are essential.

We provide free education and resources for Speech Language Pathologists and parents. See more on our website: https://childapraxiatreatment.org/
